items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: when Red come in the band... They were friends. I mean, they kidded and kidded and kidded...

ctx.x: Well, I once cornered Al Nicholas about the Russell band, and he said, "We all played the same music. We all had a good time."

Yeah, it was just like a family. And when Red come in the band, him and Higgenbotham, oh brother... You wouldn't believe it. Boy, Red would make Higgy so mad! And his nose would swell up... Well, Higgy would be in tears. Red could make him that mad. 'Course, Red could make anybody mad. Red was...
